Phase 1 — Query IR + node-tree executor + EXPLAIN renderer (batch 2: P0h header, P0a, P0b). Builds: bind AST -> Query (RangeTbl entries, TargetEntry, Var{rti,attno,ty}, RestrictInfo{security_level, leakproof, required_relids}); a real plan tree for single relations and FROM-order nested loops (Seq Scan -> Filter -> Agg|Sort|Unique|Limit|ProjectSet|WindowAgg|Result; Values/Function/Subquery/CTE/Named Tuplestore/Table Function scans; ModifyTable on top for writes; LockRows for FOR UPDATE); per-node ntuples/nloops/rows_removed instrumentation; VERBOSE Output with schema qualification; complete JSON/YAML/XML key sets with zero costs; SUMMARY/BUFFERS/MEMORY/SERIALIZE/SETTINGS/GENERIC_PLAN options; EXPLAIN over EXECUTE/DECLARE/CTAS/SELECT INTO/CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW; InitPlan/SubPlan numbering; typed deparse from BoundExpr ('42'::bigint, '(0,1)'::tid, 'ATAAAA'::name, ordinals resolved, flat AND lists); RLS quals deparsed in PG order; describe walk and old read path deleted (~8-10k lines of exec.rs). Invariants kept by construction: RawScan single exit + UnrestrictedTable proof on the Path, ReadPermit before any read (inherited for tree children), statement-level snapshot/read_ts/GC pin, check_query_canceled at node boundaries, RangeScanner leaves for sharded relations (plan_dist paths always preferred), scalar-function request channel reachable from node bodies.
